summary.zh-Hans: 温哥华海滨步道包含环绕斯坦利公园的一段。步行与慢跑区域靠近水边，骑行与轮滑区域在内侧，分区设有标识。
summary.en: Vancouver’s seaside path includes a section around Stanley Park. Marked areas separate walkers and joggers nearer the water from cyclists and inline skaters on the inside.

summary.zh-Hans: 温哥华布洛代尔温室以圆顶结构覆盖展区，种植热带与亚热带雨林植物。
summary.en: Vancouver’s Bloedel Conservatory houses tropical and subtropical rainforest plants beneath a dome.

summary.zh-Hans: 温哥华有供应 aburi 炙烧寿司，以火焰轻炙海鲜表面，为寿司带来不同的风味和口感。
summary.en: Vancouver serves aburi sushi, lightly flame-searing seafood to change its flavour and texture.

summary.zh-Hans: 在温哥华也能品尝到纳奈莫方块。一种配方有饼屑、椰蓉和坚果底层，卡仕达粉黄油甜馅，以及巧克力顶层。
summary.en: Nanaimo bars are also served in Vancouver. One recipe layers a crumb, coconut and nut base, a custard-powder butter filling and a chocolate top.
